Subject: Request to narrow/demo timing — CFO travel + spend freeze

Thanks for the invite, Mina. Quick heads-up: our CFO, Michael, has been pulled into an unexpected roadshow next week and Finance just signaled a temporary spend freeze while they finalize the FY28 reforecast.

We still want to see Redwood, but the full product walkthrough needs to be lighter for now. Would your team be open to a 20–30 minute focused demo (key outcomes, performance/cost summary, and a quick Q&A) sometime after the spend-hold lifts? Preferably the week of Mar 20 so we can get Michael on.

If you have a checklist of must-see items for a short block, send it over — I'll circulate internally.

Thanks,
Anjali
Sr. Product Manager — PolarWave

- 3:00–12:00 performance & latency demo (hosted vs quantized)
- 12:00–18:00 cost controls (batching, caching, routing policies)
- 18:00–23:00 rollout/fallover and security brief (private options)
- 23:00–25:00 Q&A + next steps (PO/PO template)

Tentative slots (PST): Mar 21 10:30–10:55, Mar 22 14:00–14:25, Mar 23 08:30–08:55. If any of those look close, I'll send a Calendar hold and include a short recording + detailed runbook after.

Attaching: polarwave-demo-agenda.pdf, polarwave-PO-template.docx
